_comment: Cross-driver updater scalars and release artifact names. Single source replacing per-file literals in the Windows, macOS and Linux updaters and release CI. macOS and Linux read this file at require-time via Paths.shared; the Windows driver has no JSON reader at include time and reads the generated windows/_generated/update_schedule.ahk (npm run codegen:update-schedule) plus inline scalars pinned by tools/test/test-updater-constants-single-source.cjs. timing: the automatic-check schedule every driver applies through _shared/modules/updater/schedule.js and its ports (vectors in schedule_vectors.json). check_interval_presets are the menu's frequency choices in display order (label: menu.about.frequency.<code>; 'never' is 0 and disables automatic checks); a saved value outside them snaps to the nearest preset by ratio. boot_check_delay_sec also applies after a wake. jitter_percent of the interval, capped at jitter_max_sec, spreads checks deterministically per install; failure_backoff_sec is the retry delay after 1, 2 and 3+ consecutive failures, never longer than the interval; reevaluate_sec bounds every timer so a suspended machine or a monotonic timer never delays a due check by more than that. check_state.storage_key names the runtime record (last_check_at, last_success_at, failures, seed, last_notified_tag) each driver keeps in its Storage port. release_sources: URL templates ({owner}/{repo}) and budgets of the changelog window, which tries the REST API first and the public Atom feed when the API is blocked or slow; ui_watchdog_sec must exceed proxy_resolve_timeout_sec + 2 * source_timeout_sec. update_check: the release list every update channel reads; each driver keeps its channel's latest release through the shared registry (channels.json), since /releases/latest ignores prereleases and answers 404 while a channel has no release.
